entities.summary: Hossein Kharrazi Dehkordi was an Iranian military officer who served as the commander of the IRGC's 14th Imam Hussein Division during the Iran–Iraq War. A partisan of the Iranian Revolution and notable commander in the Iran–Iraq War, Kharrazi participated in many battles and operations during the war, notablly the First Battle of al-Faw, which resulted in the capture of Iraq's Al-Faw Peninsula. In the Siege of Basra, Kharrazi served as commander of the vanguard forces, and was killed by shrapnel from a mortar shell during the battle.
